description: Business object for the routing explanation card — shows triggered rule, threshold, and next action

properties.name: title
properties.description: Header title for the routing explanation card

properties.name: explanation
properties.description: Free-text explanation of why this routing rule was triggered

properties.name: ruleId
properties.description: Identifier of the triggered routing rule

properties.name: triggeredByAmount
properties.description: Amount or value that triggered the rule (formatted string)

properties.name: threshold
properties.description: Threshold value that the triggeredByAmount exceeded (formatted string)

properties.name: nextAction
properties.description: Key of the recommended next action emitted when link is clicked
